The roll burns: nobody can prove what anyone owes; the gang scatters on the shore, and MQ03 decides whether their months stand. Three places within a day change: the camp (the cutting withdrawn, the clutch grey, the uxith dark), the barge (the crew parent off), the paddies behind the camp (the families on the shore).

The Owing roll (labour-and-bondage §2): the debt is months owed, with months added for food; the holder is a Lilmoth debt-labour broker who bought the gang's months from earlier holders (drift 2, transferable) and hires it to Hereguard Plantation; the overseer reads the roll; the exit in law is working the months off, and in practice the food months outrun the work, so the gang families are born into it. The bound want to be home under their own Hist, and have the right to refuse help: the washed-out woman will not leave the gang while her daughter owes.
none the player can stop: the cell cuts the roots at dusk as the player is at the fire; the player can only choose which one of the three witnesses lives

Two of the gang are visibly washed out from years away from their Hist, and their cutting is cut; the player's own line is blank, so no amount of work can pay it down. Whoever the player does not reach in the burning camp dies, and the gang families lose their clutch.

The cutting's withdrawal: the light in the cutting goes out, the sap stops, the uxith goes dark, in front of the gang families, with the harvest at its roots as the officiant and the severed clutch as the sign.

e-mine: the player walks Lilmoth owing no broker; the survivor goes to Soulrest on the broker's barge at dawn and their greeting is gone; the broker's barge at Dock1 is empty of the gang; Salts-The-Catch sells to the player as to a neighbour; e-theirs: the survivor walks out of Lilmoth by the shore road for Nine Bends, the broker greets the player at Dock1 as a hand he will find a witness for, Nesh-Deeka calls the player a kind fool; e-no-release: the survivor and the player's claim go with the broker, the house is quiet. In each a new topic (the broker), one standing moves (the Reed), and one thing becomes impossible (the survivor's release, or the player's).

The Owing (labour-and-bondage §2): the debt is months owed and months added for food, held by a Lilmoth debt-labour broker who bought them from earlier holders (drift 2) and hires the gang out (QA7). The roll is burnt, so the months stand only on the word of those who heard them read; the exit in law is a release the holder speaks before witnesses, or the months worked off; the exit in practice is the broker's price. The bound want to go home under their own Hist and may refuse help: the survivor will not swear falsely that the months were never read, and Dives-Without-A-Rope will not leave while her daughter owes.

A survivor who refuses to bear witness bears the broker's spite at the next hire (e-mine and e-no-release take them to Soulrest); a release for the player is a release not given to the survivor; the families' months stand in every ending, because the broker frees one hand's months for one price and no more.
